project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming :: Deployable Assemblies
project.description:
Deployable, independently-containerizable assemblies - one per framework, for the launcher service. Mirrors forwardmeasure-entity-intelligence-deployments' and forwardmeasure-openworkflow's own *-deployments module exactly: this is where the actual bootable-app dependency assembly and container-image Maven wiring live, separate from the framework-binding library modules those bindings themselves stay in (forwardmeasure-data-streaming-launcher-{quarkus,spring,micronaut}).
The two batch-job runners (executor-pekko/executor-spark) deliberately have no entry here - they are plain main() programs, not framework-bound services, so they don't need a per-framework deployable split. If that ever changes (see the design plan's D4 note on a possible future continuous/always-on execution mode), their own deployment leaves would belong here too.
